highlights: Implemented Isaac Lab tutorial scripts demonstrating different physics backends and the use of PyTorch and NVIDIA Warp.
Trained Franka and SO-101 arms to perform lifting tasks using curriculum-based reinforcement learning with PPO.
Implemented a belief-and-heuristics-based framework to construct robust lane-level road topology with spatiotemporal fusion.
Served as a monorepo code approver, reviewing component PRs and driving design iterations to improve system-level behavior.
Owned code quality through Coverity analysis and code coverage checks, supporting compliance with AUTOSAR coding guidelines.
Improved development efficiency by building debugging tools, sharing best practices, and developing automated workflows.

projects.title: Highway Navigation on Autopilot (HNOA)
highlights: Delivered China’s first mapless HNOA on SGMW YunDuo using a TI TDA4VH automotive SoC (32 TOPS) and a 1R7V sensor configuration. Features included automatic activation/degradation, on/off-ramp navigation, intelligent lane selection, overtaking, speed adaptation, and avoidance of diversion areas and static obstacles. As of December 2023, the system had served 2,300 customers across 610,000 km of autonomous driving.

Platformized HNOA across vehicle models from multiple OEMs (Volkswagen, BYD, SGMW, Chery, and Great Wall Motor) supporting different SoC configurations (TI TDA4VH, Qualcomm 8650, and NVIDIA Orin) and navigation providers (AMap and Tencent Map).

Designed HNOA navigation algorithms that achieved a recognition rate of over 98% for navigation-triggered lane-change requirements using only vehicle navigation inputs (maneuvers, distance, suggested lanes, and road classes).

projects.title: City Navigation on Autopilot (CNOA)
projects.role: Navigation Algorithm Lead & Project Agile Coach
highlights: Designed and delivered CNOA navigation algorithms, achieving robust urban routing based on multi-hypothesis matching of SD maps and online lane perception. Produced a lane-level topological graph with probabilistic connectivity.
Led a 12-member CNOA Scrum team as Scrum Master, responsible for planning, tracking, and verifying JIRA Stories and Tasks.

projects.title: Memory on Driving (MOD)
highlights: Led MOD integration across Perception, Mapping, Localization, Planning, and HMI teams. Demonstrated memory map building, localization, intersection handling, and computational feasibility. The system was subsequently released to users in June 2024.

Developed navigation algorithms using dynamic programming to calculate drivable areas and a greedy algorithm to minimize lane changes. Improved decisions across multiple lane options, reduced unnecessary adherence to previously recorded trajectories, and prevented deviations from memory maps.
Optimized turning reference lines by fusing memory maps, perceived lane markers, and online static obstacles with iLQR.

Developed intersection path-planning algorithms using third-order Bézier curve optimization, lane-group combinatorial optimization, and Hybrid A* to generate smooth, collision-free reference lines that respect vehicle kinematics.
Planned 9,625 intersection paths in Shanghai, with 99% meeting the required standards and the remaining 1% correctly flagged for human review.
Deployed the algorithms to the HD-map labeling production platform, increasing labeling efficiency by over 1,000% and replacing error-prone manual operations.
